newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: UM Land proposes two-for-one bonus.
newsitem.headline: UM Land proposes two-for-one bonus.

text.p: Malaysian property company United Malayan Land Bhd said on Friday it has received regulatory approval for a two-for-one bonus issue.

In a statement issued by its merchant bankers, UM Land said the planned issue will be capitalised from revaluation reserve in company books, arising from revaluation of investment in its Seri Alam Properties Sdn Bhd subsidiary.
The revaluation of UM Land's investment in wholly-owned Seri Alam was approved by the Securities Commission at 504.88 million ringgit, compared 545.83 million proposed by the company.
The revaluation surplus on investment in Seri Alam is valued at 454.0 million ringgit.
UM Land said the company expects to be able to maintain a gross dividend rate of 12.5 percent for the financial year ended July 31, 1997.
The planned bonus issue is further subject to shareholder approval.
